body.name: Exact lock compiler
body.construction: \(\operatorname{LockCompile}\) applies rational row reduction to \(E_T\) and \(b_T\).  When the augmented-rank test passes, it selects \(q\in\ker(E_T)\cap\mathbb Q^{\dim(T)}\) with \(b_Tq\neq0\), sets \(v=R_Tq\), computes an exact positivity-and-representation radius \(\delta\in\mathbb Q_{>0}\), chooses a rational \(t\) with \(0<|t|<\delta\), and sets \(\mathbf M_0=\mathbf M(0)\) and \(\mathbf M_1=\mathbf M(t)\).  It copies the supplied terminal state \(\rho\), the displayed legal trace \(\pi\) with its inherited restrictions of \((x,c)\), the represented graphs \(\mathcal M,\mathcal G\), and the whole-terminal-intervention forests \(F,F'\) with root set \(R_F\), and expands these data together with the two models and their exact rational evaluation tables into \(\Gamma\).
